s: Identify the person who was appointed as Dictator for Andhra region to conduct Salt Satyagraha
x:
During the Salt Satyagraha (1930), Konda Venkatappayya was appointed as the "Dictator" (chief organizer) for Andhra by the Indian National Congress. He coordinated civil disobedience activities, mobilized volunteers and organized salt law violations across Andhra. His leadership greatly strengthened the Salt Satyagraha in the Telugu-speaking region.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam were known for their production of
x:
Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam, located in the present-day Prakasam district, were historically famous for salt production. Their coastal location and extensive salt pans made them important centres for manufacturing and trading salt during both the pre-colonial and British periods. Salt production formed an important part of the local economy, and the region contributed significantly to the salt trade along the Coromandel Coast. During the British period, salt became an important source of government revenue through the imposition of the Salt Tax, which later became the focus of Gandhiji's Civil Disobedience Movement. Although the region also engaged in agriculture and trade, Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam are particularly remembered for their salt industry.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
